strings.crash.title: This page stopped responding
strings.crash.detail: Its process ended unexpectedly. Reloading usually brings it back — the rest of your tabs are untouched.
strings.crash.killedDetail: The page was not responding, so it was stopped. Reloading starts it fresh.
strings.cert.title: This connection is not private
strings.cert.note: Only if you know why this certificate is wrong. Attackers use this screen's exact conditions to read what you send. The exception applies to this certificate on this host, and is forgotten when the browser closes.
strings.error.title: Can't reach this page
strings.cert.err.generic.title: This connection is not private
strings.cert.err.generic.detail: The site's security certificate could not be verified, so the connection cannot be trusted.
strings.cert.err.date.title: Certificate has expired or is not yet valid
strings.cert.err.date.detail: The site's certificate is outside its validity dates. That happens when a certificate is not renewed — or when your device's clock is wrong.
strings.cert.err.authority.title: Certificate is not trusted
strings.cert.err.authority.detail: The certificate was not issued by an authority your system trusts. Self-signed certificates look like this — so does an interception proxy.
strings.cert.err.name.title: Certificate is for a different site
strings.cert.err.name.detail: The certificate does not list this hostname, so it cannot prove this server is who it claims to be.
strings.cert.err.revoked.title: Certificate was revoked
strings.cert.err.revoked.detail: The issuing authority withdrew this certificate. Do not proceed.
strings.cert.err.weak.title: Certificate uses a weak signature
strings.cert.err.weak.detail: The certificate is signed with an algorithm that is no longer considered safe.
